name: Rocket Sentry Test (Veterancy research)
description: Test build, not for release: logs the P-33 Missile Pistol's and A/MLS-4X Rocket Sentry's weapon fields and gives the Rocket Sentry's rocket the P-33's warhead (settings in rocket-test.ini), so Veterancy System's Rocket Sentry levels can be planned. Solo or host.
